correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs. After choosing the nearest sign representative, write the three off-diagonal Gram entries as minus one half plus perturbations x,y,z. Rank two gives the exact determinant identity 3s=Δ²+s²-4xyz. This first forces s of order Δ² and then s=Δ²/3 plus order Δ³. Near equality the active squared signed sums are 4+4x-2s and its permutations. After centering the perturbations, the sharp zero-sum inequality max q_i at least norm(q)/sqrt(6) gives the lower expansion with coefficients sqrt(8/3) and -2/9. Fresh symbolic calculation verified the determinant identity. The displayed symmetric angular perturbation has two equal active coordinates and its Taylor series attains both coefficients, proving joint sharpness.
